# Skynet Monitoring

> 24/7 commercial virtual guard and live remote video monitoring from our Security Operations Center (SOC) in Marietta, Georgia, serving Metro Atlanta and Georgia businesses.

## Overview
- **Company:** Skynet Monitoring (dedicated 24/7 monitoring division of Edge CCTV)
- **Operations Center:** 2470 Windy Hill Road, Suite 300, Marietta, GA 30067
- **Phone:** (678) 310-7570
- **Email:** sales@skynetmonitoring.com
- **Service Area:** Metro Atlanta and Georgia commercial properties (Marietta, Atlanta, Buckhead, Sandy Springs, Alpharetta, Roswell, Kennesaw, Smyrna, Decatur)
- **Licensing:** Georgia Low Voltage Contractor License No. LVU407024 (via Edge CCTV)
- **Sister Sites:** https://edgebusinesssecuritycameras.com/ and https://securitycamerasatlanta.com/
